color.interaction.hovered Use as a background overlay for elements in a hovered state when their background color cannot change, such as avatars. Introduced v0.6.0 #00000029 #ffffff33
color.interaction.pressed Use as a background overlay for elements in a pressed state when their background color cannot change, such as avatars. Introduced v0.6.0 #00000052 #ffffff5c
color.blanket Use for the screen overlay that appears with modal dialogs Introduced v0.0.15 Neutral500A #10121499

color.blanket.selected Use as a translucent blanket to communicate selection when changing the background of the selected content is not possible, such as selected Editor blocks. The content beneath remains visible. Do not use to indicate keyboard fo

color.blanket.danger Use as an overlay to communicate danger states when a simple background color change isn't possible, such as deletion of Editor block elements Introduced v0.6.0 #EF5C4814 #E3493514

elevation.shadow.overflow.perimeter Use only when elevation.shadow.overflow is not technically feasible to implement. Pair with elevation.shadow.overflow.spread to replicate the overflow shadow. Introduced v0.10.32 #1E1F211f #01040480

elevation.shadow.overflow.spread Use only when elevation.shadow.overflow is not technically feasible to implement. Pair with elevation.shadow.overflow.perimeter to replicate the overflow shadow. Introduced v0.10.32 #1E1F2129 #0104048f
